nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent instructions for the CLI app describing its cmd-ts/tree-sitter architecture, build and test commands, plus an injected Packmind standards index.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.MD
nodes.summary: Release history of the Packmind CLI, with an Unreleased section and per-version Added/Changed/Fixed entries for commands like install and distribution record.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code guidance for the packmind-cli Nx project: command aggregation in src/main.ts, pointers to CLI standards, and the difference between the CJS bundle build and Bun executables.

nodes.name: MACOS_SIGNING_SETUP.md
nodes.summary: Setup guide for macOS code signing and notarization of CLI binaries in CI, covering required GitHub secrets, entitlements, testing modes and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: MACOS_SIGNING_SUMMARY.md
nodes.summary: Implementation summary of macOS CLI signing: the minimal entitlements file and the GitHub Actions workflow changes that sign the Bun-built binaries.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main CLI README covering requirements, running from source, bundled and standalone Bun builds per platform, macOS signing, auth/lint usage, architecture and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: RELEASING.md
nodes.summary: Short release procedure for packmind-cli, including the Unreleased changelog template with Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed sections.

nodes.name: WASM_EMBEDDING.md
nodes.summary: Explains how tree-sitter WASM parser files are embedded into Bun-compiled CLI executables, the build process, resulting file sizes and distribution notes.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun configuration for CLI compilation, disabling dev installs and setting no external packages so everything is embedded in the executable.

nodes.name: entitlements.plist
nodes.summary: macOS hardened-runtime entitlements (JIT, unsigned executable memory, disabled page protection) applied when signing the Bun-built CLI binary.

nodes.name: knip.json
nodes.summary: Knip dead-code analysis configuration for the CLI, using src/main.ts as entry and ignoring spec and mock files.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm package manifest for @packmind/cli, declaring the packmind/packmind-cli bin entries pointing to main.cjs and the files published (bundle, WASM parsers, stubs, changelog).

nodes.name: packmind-lock.json
nodes.summary: Packmind lockfile recording the installed @cli/implementation package, target agents and the distributed standard/skill artifacts with their versions and files.

nodes.name: packmind.json
nodes.summary: Packmind CLI manifest declaring that this app consumes the @cli/implementation playbook package.

nodes.name: project.json
nodes.summary: Nx project configuration for packmind-cli defining typecheck, build, publish bundle, Bun executable targets per platform, run and test targets.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript app build config for the CLI emitting CommonJS with Node types, excluding tests and mocks.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript config for the CLI project extending the effective base config and referencing app and spec configs with esModuleInterop.
